name: Boston Ujima Project
description: A cooperative business, arts, and investment ecosystem built by and for Boston's working-class Black, Indigenous, and communities of color. Takes its name from "ujima" (Swahili for collective work and responsibility). Runs a democratically governed community investment fund that residents and members vote on, alongside business support and cultural organizing, aiming to build local economic democracy rather than rely on extractive outside capital. A New Economy Coalition member organization.

notRepresentable: #UjimaWednesdays runs every Wednesday at 6pm, and Biplaw Mondays open restaurant office hours run weekly. A single event date cannot express a weekly cadence, so only specific dated instances are listed.
Ujima Cafe is a twice-monthly series; the same limitation applies.
